authority: Original PR #1 alpha-first continuation. Terminal wealth and cross-scope alpha remain the discovery priority; MDD/orders/turnover are recorded diagnostics at this stage.

evidence.formal_tail: 199-case formal matrix: treatment/control minimum 0.220985 with early ordinary full-book displacement driving severe path divergence in cardinality_16 and other tail cases.
evidence.shadow_finding: Universal one-step challenger shadow confirmation raised leader-removal wealth to 1.890058 but collapsed union/common-five to 4.668940/7.078675. Delaying every displacement is therefore too broad. Current-leader trace shows marginal crossings such as union 2023-02-07 challenger 1.650218 versus displaced campaign reference 1.643112, while valuable handoffs can be much stronger (e.g. common-five 2023-04-19 challenger 2.549696 versus displaced reference 0.960532). No numerical gap threshold will be searched.

economic_hypothesis: A funded two-position book has two causally observed campaign admission standards. A new challenger should obtain same-close liquidation authority only when its current causal score clears the strongest admission reference of the funded book, not merely the weakest incumbent's reference. This creates a parameter-free portfolio opportunity-cost hurdle: marginal challengers cannot churn a healthy high-standard book, while genuinely dominant opportunities can still replace the weakest decayed campaign immediately.
control: Exact current offensive_fresh_challenger_authority treatment, plus an unchanged trend_book baseline recorded by the study runner.

treatment.base: Reuse offensive_fresh_challenger_authority unchanged for acute invalidation, settled reference rearm, campaign provenance, failed-fill continuity, vacancy funding, exits and execution.
treatment.full_book_hurdle: Only for the existing ordinary full-book ALPHA_DECAY_DISPLACEMENT path: determine the finite owned admission references of all actually held campaigns (using a finite pending admission reference for newly observed held inventory exactly as the base owner does). The deterministic challenger may displace the deterministic weakest decayed incumbent only if challenger_score is strictly greater than the maximum finite admission reference among all actually held campaigns. If the challenger does not clear that book-level hurdle, hold the funded book for this close. No waiting state is created.
treatment.other_paths: Security exits, retired-exit retries, acute/reference rearm, failed-fill fresh-authority displacement, ordinary vacancy fills, actual inventory reconciliation and all unrelated symbols remain exactly parent-authoritative.
treatment.execution: No forecast sale proceeds; unchanged next-session execution, T+1, price limits, prior-volume capacity, board lots, commission and slippage.

structural_difference: Not shadow-opportunity authority: no nomination state, no later-close confirmation and no score-appreciation requirement.
Not leadership_handover: no score multiplier, confirmation count or cooldown.
Not old theme/leader slots: no sector identity, designated leader slot or reserved capacity.
Not relative_campaign_owner: no maturity window or benchmark-relative campaign review.
Not a score-margin parameter: the hurdle is the strongest already-owned causal admission reference, an endogenous state value with no tunable constant.

measurement.promotion_rule: Beat the current offensive_fresh_challenger_authority mean-log objective and do not reduce its minimum wealth. Baseline-only improvement is insufficient. If promoted, evaluate full 896-session history before any formal matrix.
measurement.failure_rule: If rejected, preserve the failure and do not search multipliers, margins, confirmation days, lookbacks, position counts or pool-specific variants.
